A new chapter
starts with you

Life can ask you to begin again. You deserve someone beside you as you do.

DÉA’s work is personal. As a mother of five, a Brazilian-born adoptee, and a woman who has navigated divorce, she brings lived experience to conversations about change.

Her coaching centers on women’s empowerment, marriage, family, and relationships. Her own journey is rooted in faith, and her door is open to people of every background, with faith or without.

Read DÉA’s story

Adopted alongside her fraternal twin in Brazil, DÉA is now a mother of five and a grandmother. Divorce, faith, and rebuilding her own life shape the way she connects with others.

Dance scholarships at the Joffrey Ballet and Alvin Ailey American Dance Theater brought her to the United States. Her creative path continued through singing, songwriting, entrepreneurship, and podcasting.

Training & experience

  • Marriage and family coaching, and divorced women’s coaching — Light University / American Association of Christian Counselors.
  • Certified Trauma Healing Facilitator — Trauma Healing Institute.

Her Mama Taco Towel invention received a Huggies MomInspired grant. Her charitable work in Uganda earned the President’s Call to Service Award.

Before we talk

Is this for me?

DÉA works with women, men, and couples. Her areas of focus include women’s empowerment, marriage, family, and life after divorce. A consultation is a place to discuss whether her approach fits what you’re looking for.

Do I need to share her faith?

No. Faith is part of DÉA’s personal story, and she welcomes people of all backgrounds, including those with no religious faith.

How do I get started?

Send DÉA a message to request a consultation or ask about mentorship. You can share a little about what brings you here, even if you don’t have all the words yet.

What if plans change?

Please give at least 24 hours’ notice to cancel or reschedule a coaching appointment. Contact DÉA directly to arrange a new time.
